workflows.name: Weekly Horizon Summary
workflows.events_section:
schedule:
    # GitHub scheduled workflows use UTC and can be heavily delayed at the top
    # of the hour. 00:17 UTC is 08:17 Asia/Shanghai.
    - cron: '17 0 * * 1'   # weekly, Mondays 00:17 UTC (02:17 Paris)
  workflow_dispatch:      # Allow manual trigger

workflows.name: Deploy Docs
workflows.events_section:
push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['docs/**']

workflows.name: Horizon intelligence archive
workflows.events_section:
schedule:
    - cron: '23 6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      profile_id:
        description: Approved profile ID (empty runs standard set)
        required: false
        type: string
      lookback_hours:
        description: Lookback hours (1–168)
        required: false
        default: '48'
        type: string

workflows.name: Research archive regression
workflows.events_section:
pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/research/**'
      - 'schemas/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - '.github/workflows/horizon-intel.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/research-validation.yml'
  push:
    branches: [fix/archive-provenance-compat]

workflows.name: Funding document research and enhancement
workflows.events_section:
workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [feature/program-intelligence-implementation]
    paths:
      - 'research/funding-de-eu/Funding DK (DE missing).md'
      - 'config/funding-research.json'
      - 'config/funding-sources.json'
      - 'src/research/funding/**'
      - 'scripts/funding_research.py'
      - '.github/workflows/funding-research.yml'
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 7 * * 1'

workflows.name: Horizon intelligence archive
workflows.events_section:
schedule:
    - cron: '23 6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      funding_review_qualification:
        description: Explicit isolated data-PR test with the automatic job token; never targets main
        type: boolean
        default: false
      funding_acceptance:
        description: Independent-run funding acceptance (also select funding_qualification)
        type: boolean
        default: false
      funding_qualification:
        description: Read-only funding verification with two consecutive executions
        type: boolean
        default: false
      program_qualification:
        description: Read-only program qualification; never publishes
        type: boolean
        default: false
      research_ref:
        description: Approved same-repository head; must match selected workflow ref
        type: string
        default: ''
      previous_run_id:
        description: Optional prior qualification run for fresh-runner comparison
        type: string
        default: ''
      profile_id:
        description: Approved profile ID (empty runs standard set)
        required: false
        type: string
      lookback_hours:
        description: Lookback hours (1–168)
        required: false
        default: '48'
        type: string

workflows.events_section:
pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/research/**'

      - 'scripts/**'

      - 'research/funding-de-eu/**'
      - 'schemas/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - '.github/workflows/**'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
  push:
    branches: [main, 'feature/**', 'research/**', 'automation/**', fix/archive-provenance-compat]

workflows.name: Technical radar fleet
workflows.events_section:
workflow_dispatch:
  # Prepared schedules stay inactive until a reviewed default-branch merge AND
  # config/radar/registry.json schedule_enabled=true. No existing cron is changed.
  schedule:
    - cron: '13 2,14 * * *'
    - cron: '0 18 * * 5'

workflows.name: Isolated technical radar worker
workflows.events_section:
workflow_call:
    inputs:
      radar:
        required: true
        type: string
      publication:
        required: true
        type: boolean
    secrets:
      HORIZON_DECISION_API_KEY:
        required: false
